summary: Open Source Routing Machine is a high-performance routing engine designed to process OpenStreetMap data. It provides an HTTP API, a C++ library interface, and a Node.js wrapper to calculate paths and navigation routes. The software is written in C++ and released under the BSD-2-Clause licence.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need to build custom mapping applications or require local, high-speed routing services using OpenStreetMap data without relying on third-party APIs.
watchOut: Setting up and preprocessing large geographical datasets can be computationally demanding and requires careful hardware planning. It also has a specific dependency on OpenStreetMap data formats.
deployNotes: As a C++ application, you will typically need to allocate sufficient RAM and persistent storage for the processed map data. Placing the HTTP API behind a standard reverse proxy is recommended for handling TLS termination and access control.
